description: Na₃W₂N₅ is Chalcostibite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.77 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.61 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.96 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four N atoms. There are two shorter (2.36 Å) and two longer (2.41 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.98 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing WN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of W-N bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.94 Å. There are five inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one W atom. In the second N site, N is bonded to four Na and one W atom to form distorted NNa₄W trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NNa₄W trigonal bipyramids, corners with three equivalent NNa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NNa₄W trigonal bipyramid. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the fifth N site, N is bonded to two Na and two W atoms to form distorted NNa₂W₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NNa₄W trigonal bipyramids and  a cornercorner with one NNa₂W₂ trigonal pyramid.
